messages:
alex (DevEx): Heads-up: onboarding quickstart failed for a customer during key rotation; app started returning 401 shortly after we rotated the project key. repro below.
nisha (SDK): ugh. which env vars were set in the container? project-scoped vs org-scoped matters a lot here
alex (DevEx): container had: 
```
REDWOOD_PROJECT=org-rocket
REDWOOD_API_KEY=org:oldkey
REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj:newkey
```
We updated REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY in k8s but image still had REDWOOD_API_KEY baked in. Requests left device with org:oldkey and were denied (401).
frank (PM): we should treat presence of both keys as a risky state and guide users during rotation. Docs currently don't call out the precedence clearly.
nisha (SDK): looked into SDK env resolution. Current code picks the first non-empty of [REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, REDWOOD_CLI_TOKEN]. That's wrong when REDWOOD_PROJECT is defined. Expect behaviour: if REDWOOD_PROJECT is set, prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, else allow REDWOOD_API_KEY as org-level fallback.
tom (Infra): server logs show token rejected with 401, message: "invalid credentials". Can we return a clearer error for scope mismatches? e.g. code: auth.scope_mismatch with detail "token not valid for project org-rocket". Would make onboarding UX much easier.
nisha (SDK): agreed. I'll change client-side precedence logic and add a one-time startup warning when both keys present: `console.warn('Both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY set; if REDWOOD_PROJECT is configured, project key will be used')`. Also adding a CLI `redwood doctor --auth` check to flag this case.
frank (PM): add a small inline note in the quickstart page and an in-console hint for first-run users. That should cut support tickets.
alex (DevEx): also suggest server change: return 403 with structured body instead of generic 401 for scope mismatch. and include `x-redwood-expected-scope: project` header so SDKs can surface targeted guidance.
tom (Infra): we can implement structured error + header. also propose not auto-retrying on 401/403 from auth failures, only on 429/5xx. otherwise we keep hammering with old creds during rotation.
nisha (SDK): good catch. will update retry policy (no auth retries) and emit metrics when auth mismatch occurs so onboarding funnel can be instrumented.
deploy-bot: deploy: staging - sdk-js@0.10.0-alpha rolling to staging (commit a1b2c3)
nisha (SDK): PR: https://git.internal/pulls/1998 - fixes env precedence + adds doctor check + adjusts retry policy. Tests added for precedence matrix.
deploy-bot: ci: tests: 78 passed, 2 flaky - rerun queued
deploy-bot: ci: rerun succeeded, all tests passed
nisha (SDK): cut release sdk-js v0.10.0 with changelog: "Respect REDWOOD_PROJECT when resolving credentials; warn when both org and project keys are present; avoid retrying on auth failures; improved quickstart messaging."
alex (DevEx): validated sample app in staging. rotation now works when we replace project key; fallback no longer silently picks org key. Closing out, will update onboarding doc with snippet and `redwood doctor` note. Thanks everyone :rocket:
